scripts.build: node --input-type=module -e "import {rmSync} from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', {recursive:true, force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --strict --esModuleInterop index.ts plugins/*.ts utils/*.ts tests/*.ts
